The '''Malarian laser pistol''' was a type of handheld [[Laser/Legends|laser]] weapon used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Storm" /> During the year [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]], two of the pistols were carried by [[Borokii]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] who were in the group of [[Security guard/Legends|sentinels]] that welcomed a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] delegation [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|coming to negotiate]] a treaty between the Borokii, the ruling clan of [[Ansionian]] nomads, the [[Alwari]], and the more technologically-advanced [[Unity of Community|city-dwelling Ansionians]] represented by the [[Unity Council]].<ref name="Storm" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Malarian laser pistol first appeared in ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'', a [[2002]] novel written by [[Alan Dean Foster]]. The book does not specify whether the weapon was created by the [[Malarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] or by one of the members of the [[Malarian Alliance]],<ref name="Storm" /> a treaty that involved both the Ansionians and the Malarians.<ref name="MA">{{CSWECite|II|279|Malarian Alliance}}</ref>
